Tooltip_GrenadeBandolier: Provides 4 grenade attachment slots. Drag grenades onto the attachment icons to holster them there for quick access - it is not a storage container.
Tooltip_FlareBurning: A lit signal flare, burning brightly and giving off sparks and smoke. Throw it to mark a location or light up the area.
Tooltip_FlareSpent: A burnt-out signal flare. No longer useful.
Tooltip_ClaymoreRemote: An M18A1 Claymore mine fitted with a remote trigger instead of a motion sensor. Detonate it from a distance using a remote control.
Tooltip_Explosives_DEBUG_SPAWN_KEY: Hold Shift and press this key to spawn a single flashbang directly into your inventory, for testing grenade trajectories/collisions without needing full debug mode.
Tooltip_Mk2Shell: An unfinished, hollow shell for an Mk2 fragmentation grenade. Needs a fuze assembly, striker lever and gunpowder to become a working grenade.
Tooltip_M26Shell: An unfinished, hollow shell for an M26 fragmentation grenade. Needs a fuze assembly, striker lever and gunpowder to become a working grenade.
Tooltip_M67Shell: An unfinished, hollow shell for an M67 fragmentation grenade. Needs a fuze assembly, striker lever and gunpowder to become a working grenade.
Tooltip_StrikerLever: A spring-loaded striker lever, forged from scrap metal. Needed to assemble any hand grenade - it's what triggers the fuse when released.
Tooltip_Mk2FuzeAssembly: A hand-built fuze assembly for an Mk2 grenade shell - primer, delay element, and wiring, ready to be screwed into the shell.
Tooltip_M26FuzeAssembly: A hand-built fuze assembly for an M26 grenade shell - primer, delay element, and wiring, ready to be screwed into the shell.
Tooltip_M67FuzeAssembly: A hand-built fuze assembly for an M67 grenade shell - primer, delay element, and wiring, ready to be screwed into the shell.
